tasks.name: 额外文本过滤
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/utils/text-filter.js');
    const current = mod.getBuiltinTextFilters();
    const isOn = Array.isArray(current) && current.length > 0;
    const nextRules = isOn ? [] : [
        '\\[(?:image|ebook-image|tavern-image)\\s*:\\s*[^\\]]+\\]',
        '\\[tts:[^\\]]*\\]',
        '<state>[\\s\\S]*?</state>',
    ];
    mod.setBuiltinTextFilters(nextRules);
    mod.setFilterBuiltinPlaceholders(!isOn);
    const label = (b) => (b ? '开启' : '关闭');
    window.toastr?.success(`额外文本过滤：${label(isOn)} → ${label(!isOn)}（${nextRules.length} 条规则）`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
